facts.fact: Digital Realty opened a second facility in Nairobi in the week of the article (published 2026-09-10), adding 6.4 MW to its existing campus; the article gives no exact date, so the as_of is the publication month.

note: Amaco Hercules is proposed and Microsoft Nakuru is delayed (not facts); only Digital Realty NBO2 opening is a service fact.
